body: Residuals from the registry dialect lane (PR #960, V1-1455/1456/1457, 2026-10-16). Each may select fewer tests than a change reaches (fail-open, invariant 2): (1) an accessor call inside a template-literal substitution `${registry[key]()}` is invisible to the reader; (2) writes to the registry object after its declaration (registry.k = ..., Object.assign) are not observed; (3) under accepted NGI-V0-008, eager `new X(args)` entry arguments can reference other modules that are not followed. Suspected, not reproduced as live selection misses. Expected: each either resolves or widens with a named reason.

holds.reason: Owner decision: the fix needs an NGI-V0-008 decision in contextindex.

title: Suspected impact fail-opens in the JS/TS registry reader: accessor in a template substitution, registry writes after declaration, eager new X(args) reaching other modules
